metadata.title: The Windows app is not available yet
metadata.description: We are preparing a safe public release. For now, you can check your PC, explore the product, and see what must be verified before download.

identity.label: Demonstrative release information
identity.detail: This repository record explains the acceptance path. It is not an official signed manifest, installer, mirror, or distribution authorization.

channels.name: Stable
channels.audience: Players and general users who require the supported release policy.
channels.risk: Standard release risk after every publication gate passes.
channels.support: Supported only while the release remains current or explicitly supported.
channels.updates: Stable track only; no automatic move to Beta or Experimental.
channels.account: No account is required for a future public Stable download.

channels.name: Beta
channels.audience: Opted-in testers prepared to report pre-release behavior.
channels.risk: Pre-release behavior may change and requires explicit opt-in.
channels.support: Best-effort support with recovery guidance; not the Stable support promise.
channels.updates: Beta track only until the user deliberately returns to Stable.
channels.account: Channel consent is separate from account identity.

channels.name: Experimental
channels.audience: Hardware enthusiasts who can evaluate high-change behavior and recover safely.
channels.risk: High-change, limited-validation behavior; never presented beside Stable as an equivalent choice.
channels.support: Limited support and explicit recovery expectations.
channels.updates: Manual-only policy with a new acknowledgement for each material risk change.
channels.account: The Experimental acknowledgement cannot be inferred from a session, URL, or cookie.

releaseNotes.title: Release notes before promotion
releaseNotes.summary: These notes describe the demonstrative 1.0.0 release record. They do not announce a downloadable build.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: The public experience documents compatibility, evidence, recovery, and release-integrity review before any optimizer artifact is distributed.

sections.title: Known risks
sections.body: Windows lifecycle support and representative hardware validation remain incomplete. No performance, compatibility, or installation claim is inferred from the demonstrative record.

sections.title: Corrections
sections.body: Public release language now separates repository examples, development evidence, and future publicly trusted distribution.

sections.title: Compatibility
sections.body: Windows 10 and Windows 11 use one eligibility path while behavior is equivalent. Architecture, lifecycle, and verified hardware evidence must still agree.

sections.title: Migration
sections.body: No public artifact exists, so there is no installation or migration action. A later release must publish exact migration requirements atomically with its manifest.

sections.title: Recovery
sections.body: Cancel whenever publisher, signature, hash, size, version, compatibility, or manifest differs. Keep the application closed and use public support.

manifest.title: Demonstrative manifest fields
manifest.notice: Outside the official trust path. Values marked not issued or not approved are blocking facts, not missing UI.

fields.artifactId: Exact artifact identity bound to that manifest
fields.channel: Stable, Beta, or separately acknowledged Experimental policy
fields.windowsLifecycle: Supported Windows 10 and Windows 11 lifecycle evidence
fields.compatibility: Validated hardware and operating-system compatibility scope
fields.signatureState: Verified Authenticode chain and publisher state

verification.title: Independent verification
verification.introduction: For a future approved artifact, perform every check before running it. One disagreement blocks the flow completely.

steps.title: Authenticode and publisher
steps.body: Inspect the Windows digital signature, full certificate chain, expected publisher, and verification result. Cancel on an unknown publisher, missing signature, or chain warning.

steps.title: SHA-256
steps.body: Compute the file digest independently and compare all 64 hexadecimal characters with the canonical manifest. A single different character blocks use.

steps.title: File size
steps.body: Compare the exact byte length, not a rounded display value, with the canonical manifest.

steps.title: Version and architecture
steps.body: Confirm installer metadata, manifest version, release notes, and target architecture all identify the same release.

steps.title: Windows lifecycle and compatibility
steps.body: Confirm the current support matrix covers the operating-system lifecycle and architecture of this PC before installation.

steps.title: Canonical manifest
steps.body: Use only the repository-published canonical manifest on the controlled official origin. Mirrors and copied values do not receive the official trust mark.

verification.blocked: There is no continue-anyway action. Close the artifact, preserve only non-sensitive evidence, and contact support.

history.title: Release history
history.introduction: Notes, hash status, and safety state remain inspectable. Unsupported or unsafe binaries are not offered and downgrade is not promoted.

1.0.0.title: 1.0.0 demonstrative Stable record
1.0.0.notes: Current release-information baseline; public artifact remains unavailable.

0.9.0.title: 0.9.0 historical Beta record
0.9.0.notes: Preserved for policy history without an actionable binary.

0.8.0.title: 0.8.0 withdrawn Experimental record
0.8.0.notes: Preserved to explain withdrawal; it must not be installed or used as a downgrade target.

downloadGate.title: There is no public installer yet
downloadGate.summary: Download will appear only when the release, signature, compatibility, and recovery path are ready for real use.

reasons.artifact-unavailable: The artifact and its required evidence are not atomically available.
reasons.channel-selection-blocked: The requested channel does not have the direct consent its policy requires.
reasons.development-artifact-rejected: Development or self-signed evidence is categorically outside the public flow.
reasons.distribution-not-approved: We are still completing the checks required before publishing the installer.
reasons.historical-release-unavailable: The historical artifact is unavailable and is not offered as a downgrade.
reasons.historical-release-unsafe: The historical release is unsafe and remains non-actionable.
reasons.integrity-disagreement: At least one release, manifest, publisher, signature, hash, artifact, provenance, or compatibility fact disagrees.
reasons.official-artifact-unavailable: The canonical record declares the official artifact unavailable.
reasons.record-invalid: This release information did not pass the safety check.

downloadGate.assertive: Do not use mirrors, development installers, or links sent by third parties.

installation.title: Safe installation and cancellation guidance
installation.summary: These steps become actionable only after a future approved download. They do not imply an artifact exists today.
installation.expectedWarnings: Windows should report the exact approved publisher and a valid signature. Any different publisher, missing signature, SmartScreen uncertainty, or unexpected elevation request is a stop condition.
steps: Verify Authenticode, publisher, SHA-256, exact size, version, architecture, compatibility, and canonical manifest before running the file.
Close games and preserve work before a verified installer requests an expected system change.
Read every elevation prompt and cancel if its publisher or requested action differs from the release guidance.
After installation, confirm the installed version and retain the matching release notes and recovery guidance.
installation.cancel: Cancel without running the artifact, do not weaken Windows security, and remove the untrusted copy.
installation.support: Use public support with the release version and categorical disagreement only. Do not send credentials, device secrets, or unrelated diagnostic data.

analytics.title: Purpose-bound download measurement
analytics.body: A future public download may record only aggregate eligibility and delivery outcomes needed to operate distribution. It does not identify the PC, create an account, or silently bind a public download to account identity.
